
"use strict";




const META=D.meta, CELLS=META.cells, MX=D.matrix, NR=META.n_rows, NC=META.n_cols, SEAM=META.n_half;
const FACT=D.page_facts, AUD=D.audit, LEG=D.legacy_extensions;
const FONT=PC.font.family();
const cellToken=c=>"--cs2-"+c.split("_")[1];
const cellColor=c=>PC.css(cellToken(c));
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);
const fmt=(v,d=3)=>Number(v).toLocaleString("en-US",{minimumFractionDigits:d,maximumFractionDigits:d});
const integer=v=>Number(v).toLocaleString("en-US");
const pct=(v,d=1)=>fmt(100*v,d)+"%";
const esc=value=>String(value==null?"":value).replace(/[&<>\"]/g,ch=>({"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;"}[ch]));
const sum=(arr,fn)=>arr.reduce((a,x)=>a+fn(x),0);
const totalFiles=sum(CELLS,c=>D.cells[c].n_files);
const totalLogged=sum(CELLS,c=>D.cells[c].funnel.logged);
const totalStats=sum(CELLS,c=>D.cells[c].stats_check.n);

const raw=atob(MX.z_b64);
const Z=new Int8Array(raw.length);
for(let q=0;q<raw.length;q++)Z[q]=(raw.charCodeAt(q)<<24)>>24;
const zAt=(i,j)=>Z[i*NC+j]/MX.z_scale;
const voltAt=(i,j)=>zAt(i,j)*MX.v_std[i]+MX.v_mean[i];
const cellRows=CELLS.map((_,k)=>{const out=[];for(let i=0;i<NR;i++)if(MX.cell[i]===k)out.push(i);return out});
const defaultRow=cellRows[0][Math.floor(cellRows[0].length*FACT.default_row_fraction)];

const TOP=[
  {label:"Data provenance",sub:integer(META.total_samples)+" raw samples"},
  {label:"Design matrix",sub:integer(NR)+" × "+integer(NC)+" shape values"},
  {label:"Shape representation",sub:"PCA · UMAP · transfer · ΔQ(V)"},
  {label:"Conclusions",sub:"what the evidence supports"},
  {label:"Glossary",sub:"terms used here",role:"glossary-content"}
];
const RIBBON=[
  {stage:1,label:"Preprocess",value:integer(totalFiles)+" files → "+integer(NR)+" rows",note:"deduplicate, segment, validate"},
  {stage:2,label:"Transform",value:integer(SEAM)+" + "+integer(SEAM)+" → "+integer(NC),note:"normalize time, then z-score"},
  {stage:3,label:"Model",value:"PC1 "+pct(D.pca.pooled.evr[0]),note:"PCA without age labels"},
  {stage:4,label:"Evaluate",value:integer(CELLS.length)+" held-out cells",note:"project, correlate, inspect ΔQ(V)"}
];
const WFMAP=[
  {stage:2,anchor:"wf-2",title:"Transformation",desc:"A shape-only row removes level, scale and duration while retaining the curve geometry."},
  {stage:3,anchor:"wf-3",title:"Modelling & training",desc:"PCA and UMAP organize the rows without seeing cycle number, capacity or cell age."},
  {stage:4,anchor:"wf-4",title:"Evaluation",desc:"Whole-cell projection and withheld labels test transfer and expose the physical failure mode."}
];

const STORY_PAINTERS=[
  function(cv,g){
    const y=D.full_cycle.v, w=parseFloat(cv.style.width), h=parseFloat(cv.style.height);
    const lo=Math.min(...y), hi=Math.max(...y), sx=i=>3+i/(y.length-1)*(w-6), sy=v=>h-5-(v-lo)/(hi-lo)*(h-10);
    g.strokeStyle=PC.css("--cs2-35");g.lineWidth=2;g.lineJoin="round";g.lineCap="round";g.beginPath();
    y.forEach((v,i)=>i?g.lineTo(sx(i),sy(v)):g.moveTo(sx(i),sy(v)));g.stroke();
  },
  function(cv,g){
    const w=parseFloat(cv.style.width),h=parseFloat(cv.style.height),r0=D.xform_examples[0],r1=D.xform_examples[1];
    const rows=[r0,r1].map(ex=>MX.cycle.findIndex((c,i)=>c===ex.cycle&&MX.cell[i]===CELLS.indexOf(ex.cell)));
    const yr=PC.extent(rows.flatMap(i=>Array.from({length:NC},(_,j)=>zAt(i,j))));
    rows.forEach((ri,k)=>{g.strokeStyle=k?PC.css("--series-2"):PC.css("--series-1");g.lineWidth=1.7;g.beginPath();for(let j=0;j<NC;j++){const x=3+j/(NC-1)*(w-6),y=h-5-(zAt(ri,j)-yr[0])/(yr[1]-yr[0])*(h-10);j?g.lineTo(x,y):g.moveTo(x,y)}g.stroke()});
  },
  function(cv,g){
    const w=parseFloat(cv.style.width),h=parseFloat(cv.style.height),P=D.pca.pooled;
    const xr=PC.extent(P.s1),yr=PC.extent(P.s2);
    for(let i=0;i<NR;i+=8){g.fillStyle=cellColor(CELLS[MX.cell[i]]);g.beginPath();g.arc(3+(P.s1[i]-xr[0])/(xr[1]-xr[0])*(w-6),h-4-(P.s2[i]-yr[0])/(yr[1]-yr[0])*(h-8),1.8,0,Math.PI*2);g.fill()}
  }
];

const VIEW=PC.createViewState({
  rawCell:CELLS[0],xf:0,row:defaultRow,col:SEAM+FACT.default_discharge_offset,
  scoreColor:"cycle",umapColor:"cycle",holdout:CELLS[3],evalView:"transfer",dqCell:CELLS[0]
},{params:{
  rawCell:{values:CELLS,param:"raw"},xf:{type:"integer",min:0,max:D.xform_examples.length-1},
  row:{type:"integer",min:0,max:NR-1},col:{type:"integer",min:0,max:NC-1},
  scoreColor:{values:["cycle","cell","soh"],param:"scores"},umapColor:{values:["cycle","cell"],param:"umap"},
  holdout:{values:CELLS,param:"holdout"},evalView:{values:["transfer","dq"],param:"tab"},dqCell:{values:CELLS,param:"dq"}
}});

function flagHtml(verdict){
  const key=verdict==="ok"||verdict==="✓"?"ok":verdict==="bad"||verdict==="✗"?"bad":"warn";
  const glyph=key==="ok"?"✓":key==="bad"?"✗":"⚠";
  const path=key==="ok"?'<path d="M3 8l3 3 7-8"/>':key==="bad"?'<path d="M4 4l8 8M12 4l-8 8"/>':'<path d="M8 2l6 12H2L8 2zm0 4v4m0 2h.01"/>';
  return '<span class="flag '+key+'"><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">'+path+'</svg>'+glyph+'</span>';
}
function buildProvenance(){
  const P=D.provenance, claims=P.claims||[];
  $("provIntro").innerHTML="Each value stated in the source record is set beside a count made directly from the CALCE files. The four batteries’ archives hold <b>"+integer(AUD.workbook_exports)+"</b> exported workbooks; after removing the duplicate final exports, the analysis uses <b>"+integer(AUD.session_files_used)+"</b> workbooks (test sessions) and <b>"+integer(AUD.raw_samples)+"</b> samples logged every "+integer(META.protocol.sample_s)+" seconds, roughly "+fmt(AUD.raw_samples/CELLS.length/1000,0)+",000 per battery.";
  $("provTable").querySelector("tbody").innerHTML=claims.map(c=>'<tr><td>'+esc(c.property)+'</td><td>'+esc(c.card_says)+'</td><td>'+esc(c.file_says)+'</td><td>'+flagHtml(c.verdict)+'</td></tr>').join("");
  $("provSource").textContent=P.identifier+" · "+P.span+" · "+P.unit+".";
  $("cellInventory").innerHTML='<thead><tr><th>battery</th><th>recorded samples</th><th>record date span</th><th>sessions used</th><th>logged cycles</th><th>rows in X</th><th>cycles checked against Statistics sheet</th><th>median relative difference</th><th>over 1%</th></tr></thead><tbody>'+CELLS.map((c,k)=>{const x=D.cells[c],st=x.stats_check;return '<tr><td><span class="cell-dot" style="background:var('+cellToken(c)+')"></span>'+c+'</td><td class="num">'+integer(x.n_samples)+'</td><td>'+esc(x.date_range[0])+' → '+esc(x.date_range[1])+'</td><td class="num">'+integer(x.n_files)+'</td><td class="num">'+integer(x.funnel.logged)+'</td><td class="num">'+integer(cellRows[k].length)+'</td><td class="num">'+integer(st.n)+'</td><td class="num">'+Number(st.median_rel).toExponential(3)+'</td><td class="num">'+integer(st.n_over_1pct)+'</td></tr>'}).join("")+'</tbody>';
}
function buildFindings(){
  const drops={half:sum(CELLS,c=>D.cells[c].funnel.half_missing),protocol:sum(CELLS,c=>D.cells[c].funnel.protocol),truncated:sum(CELLS,c=>D.cells[c].funnel.truncated),resolution:sum(CELLS,c=>D.cells[c].funnel.resolution)};
  const cards=[
    ["The files are test sessions, not a table of cycles","Files must be ordered by the timestamps inside them; cycle numbers restart in every file, and capacity columns keep adding up within a file.",integer(totalFiles)+" files · "+integer(totalLogged)+" logged cycles","So the analysis rebuilds one continuous cycle count and measures each charge and discharge from its own start and end."],
    ["Two files are duplicate exports","Two batteries’ final sessions were exported twice under different dates: the files differ byte for byte, but the measurements in them are identical.",integer(FACT.duplicate_exports)+" duplicate exports · "+integer(FACT.duplicate_cycles_each)+" cycles each","Duplicates are removed by comparing the measurements, before any analysis."],
    ["Every removed cycle has a named reason","Missing halves, off-protocol cycles, truncated cycles and cycles with too few samples are counted separately.",integer(drops.half)+" half missing · "+integer(drops.protocol)+" off protocol · "+integer(drops.truncated)+" truncated · "+integer(drops.resolution)+" too few samples","The final matrix keeps "+integer(NR)+" of "+integer(totalLogged)+" logged cycles."],
    ["Recomputed capacities match the cycler’s own records","Where the cycler’s Statistics sheet records a capacity for a cycle, the capacity recomputed from the samples agrees with it.",integer(AUD.statistics_checked_cycles)+" checked cycles · largest median relative difference "+Number(AUD.max_median_relative_capacity_difference).toExponential(3),"The relative difference stays within "+FACT.capacity_check_text+"."]
  ];
  $("forensics").innerHTML=cards.map(c=>'<article class="finding"><h4>'+c[0]+'</h4><p>'+c[1]+'</p><div class="ev">'+c[2]+'</div><p class="so">'+c[3]+'</p></article>').join("");
}

function buildDesignMatrix(){
  $("heroValue").textContent=integer(NR)+" × "+integer(NC);
  $("heroNote").textContent="Each row is one screened charge–discharge cycle; each column is one fixed point in the charge or the discharge, measured as a fraction of that half’s duration.";
  $("statRow").innerHTML=[
    [integer(CELLS.length),"batteries"],[integer(META.total_samples),"raw samples"],[integer(totalLogged-NR),"cycles excluded"]
  ].map(x=>'<div class="stat"><span class="v">'+x[0]+'</span><span class="l">'+x[1]+'</span></div>').join("");
  $("dmRules").innerHTML=[
    "Order the files by the timestamps inside them, rebuild one continuous cycle count, and remove duplicate exports.",
    "Find the charge where the current is above "+fmt(FACT.charge_current_threshold,2)+" A and the discharge where it stays below "+fmt(FACT.discharge_current_threshold,1)+" A, using the current rather than the logged step number.",
    "Resample the charge and the discharge separately to "+integer(SEAM)+" points each, so the switch from charge to discharge always falls at column "+integer(SEAM)+".",
    "Standardise each row (subtract its mean voltage, divide by its spread) so only the shape remains. The removed level and spread, the durations, the capacity and the coulombic efficiency are kept as labels beside X."
  ].map(x=>"<li>"+x+"</li>").join("");
  $("fig1Title").textContent="Fig 1 · One full cycle, as the cycler logged it";
  $("fig2Title").textContent="Fig 2 · How the discharge curve changes with age";
  $("fig3Title").textContent="Fig 3 · Cycles removed by each screening rule, per battery";
  $("fig4Title").textContent="Fig 4 · From one logged cycle to one row: split, resample, standardise";
  $("fig5Title").textContent="Fig 5 · The design matrix";
  const p=META.protocol;
  $("fig1Copy").innerHTML='<p class="plot-caption"><b>How one cycle runs.</b> The cycler charges at a constant '+fmt(p.cc_a,2)+' A until the voltage reaches '+fmt(p.cv_v,1)+' V (constant current, CC), then holds the voltage while the current falls to '+fmt(p.cutoff_a,2)+' A (constant voltage, CV). After a rest, it discharges at '+fmt(Math.abs(p.dis_a),1)+' A until the voltage drops to '+fmt(p.dis_cutoff_v,1)+' V. The upper chart is the battery’s voltage; the lower chart is the current the cycler applies.</p><p class="plot-caption"><b>What the export files do.</b> File names carry the export date, not the date of the data; cycle counters restart in every file; capacity adds up within a file; and each duplicate final export would add '+integer(FACT.duplicate_cycles_each)+' cycles that were already counted.</p>';
  $("funnelNote").textContent="Counts are cycles; each removed cycle fails one of four rules.";
  $("funnelCopy").innerHTML='<b>The rules, in order.</b> “Half missing”: a file boundary cut the cycle, so only the charge or only the discharge is present. “Off protocol”: the cycle does not follow the test schedule; the batteries arrived already formed, so this check replaces a rule about initial conditioning cycles, and it removes only '+integer(AUD.dropped_by_reason.protocol)+' cycles. “Truncated”: the discharge does not reach '+fmt(FACT.truncated_discharge_v,2)+' V or lower, or the constant-voltage hold does not taper to '+fmt(FACT.truncated_cv_a,2)+' A or lower. “Too few samples”: a half has fewer than '+integer(SEAM)+' logged samples, so filling '+integer(SEAM)+' points would mean inventing data. This last rule is why the matrix stops near SOH '+fmt(FACT.coverage_soh,2)+': late discharges are short enough to fall below '+integer(SEAM)+' samples.';
  $("transformSteps").innerHTML=[
    ["Find the two halves","Use the current, not the logged step number."],
    ["Rescale time","Give each half its own "+integer(SEAM)+"-point time axis."],
    ["Standardise the row","Remove the average level and spread so only the shape remains."],
    ["Keep what was removed","Store the mean, spread, durations, capacity and CE as labels."]
  ].map((x,i)=>'<div class="pipeline-step"><b>'+(i+1)+' · '+x[0]+'</b>'+x[1]+'</div>').join("");
  $("xfHonesty").innerHTML='<b>Why two separate time axes?</b> Giving the charge and the discharge their own time axes lines up, in every row, the corner where constant current switches to constant voltage and the knee near the end of the discharge, so PCA does not have to spend components on differences in duration. Every kept half has at least '+integer(SEAM)+' samples, so resampling only ever reduces the number of points. During the constant-voltage hold, samples can be minutes apart, but the voltage is held at '+fmt(p.cv_v,3)+' V, so interpolating voltage across those gaps is justified.';
  $("matrixNote").textContent="Rows are stacked battery by battery, each in order of cycle. Colour shows the standardised voltage of each entry. The vertical line is the switch from charge to discharge, at the same column in every row.";
  $("matrixHonesty").innerHTML='<b>Labels sit beside X, not inside it.</b> Capacity, CE, durations, mean voltage and voltage spread appear in the linked tables below; PCA never receives them.';
  $("matrixCopy").innerHTML='<b>Rows and columns answer different questions.</b> A row is everything PCA knows about one cycle. A column shows how the voltage at one point of the cycle changes across life. The selected mid-discharge column already shows a pattern with age; PCA finds the weighted combination of all '+integer(NC)+' columns that varies most.';
  buildFunnelTable();
}

function buildFunnelTable(){
  let totals={files:0,logged:0,half_missing:0,protocol:0,truncated:0,resolution:0,rows:0};
  const body=CELLS.map(c=>{const f=D.cells[c].funnel;totals.files+=D.cells[c].n_files;Object.keys(f).forEach(k=>totals[k]+=f[k]);return '<tr><td><span class="cell-dot" style="background:var('+cellToken(c)+')"></span>'+c+'</td><td class="num">'+D.cells[c].n_files+'</td><td class="num">'+integer(f.logged)+'</td><td class="num">'+f.half_missing+'</td><td class="num">'+f.protocol+'</td><td class="num">'+f.truncated+'</td><td class="num">'+f.resolution+'</td><td class="num"><b>'+integer(f.rows)+'</b></td><td class="num">'+fmt(100*f.rows/f.logged,1)+'%</td></tr>'}).join("");
  $("funnelTable").innerHTML='<thead><tr><th>battery</th><th>files</th><th>logged</th><th>half missing</th><th>off protocol</th><th>truncated</th><th>too few samples</th><th>rows in X</th><th>kept</th></tr></thead><tbody>'+body+'<tr><td><b>total</b></td><td class="num"><b>'+totals.files+'</b></td><td class="num"><b>'+integer(totals.logged)+'</b></td><td class="num"><b>'+totals.half_missing+'</b></td><td class="num"><b>'+totals.protocol+'</b></td><td class="num"><b>'+totals.truncated+'</b></td><td class="num"><b>'+totals.resolution+'</b></td><td class="num"><b>'+integer(totals.rows)+'</b></td><td class="num"><b>'+fmt(100*totals.rows/totals.logged,1)+'%</b></td></tr></tbody>';
}

function buildAnalysisText(){
  const li=LEG.li_metal_notes_comparison;
  $("analysisTransformCopy").innerHTML="Every retained cycle is represented by <b>"+integer(NC)+"</b> standardised voltage values: "+integer(SEAM)+" for the charge and "+integer(SEAM)+" for the discharge. Cycle number, capacity, duration and battery identity are kept out of the model.";
  $("analysisModelCopy").innerHTML="PCA (principal component analysis) receives only the shape rows. It finds the combinations of columns along which the rows differ most, called principal components; a row’s position along one of them is its score. Cycle number and capacity are kept aside and used only afterwards, to check what the components mean. UMAP, a nonlinear method, gives a second view of the same rows.";
  $("analysisEvalCopy").innerHTML="The main test fits PCA on three batteries and applies it to the fourth, which the fit never saw. The resulting scores are then compared with cycle number and with capacity, neither of which was part of X. Use “Evaluation view” to switch between this test and the ΔQ(V) features.";
  $("fig6Title").textContent="Fig 6 · PCA on all four batteries together: the first component carries "+fmt(100*D.pca.pooled.evr[0],1)+"% of the shape variance";
  $("fig7Title").textContent="Fig 7 · A separate PCA on each battery finds the same first component";
  $("fig8Title").textContent="Fig 8 · UMAP: a second, nonlinear view";
  $("fig9Title").textContent="Fig 9 · Leave one battery out: fit PCA on three, project the fourth";
  $("fig10Title").textContent="Fig 10 · PC1 against capacity, which PCA never saw";
  $("fig11Title").textContent="Fig 11 · ΔQ(V): a lifetime feature from Severson et al., rebuilt from these curves";
  $("poolingCallout").innerHTML='<b>Can the four batteries be analysed together?</b> Only if PC1 does not simply tell one battery from another. Here η²(battery), the share of PC1’s variation explained by which battery a cycle came from, is <b>'+fmt(D.pca.pooled.eta2_cell.pc1,3)+'</b>, so battery identity explains little of PC1. In an earlier analysis of lithium-metal batteries with different chemistries and test schedules, PC1 fitted on all of them instead separated the chemistries (η² = '+fmt(li.cell_identity_eta_squared,2)+'), and two truncated cycles changed the rank correlation from '+fmt(li.correlation_before_truncation,2)+' to '+fmt(li.correlation_after_truncation,2)+'; this is why truncated cycles are screened out here.';
  $("pooledCaption").innerHTML='<b>What PC1 measures.</b> A loading is the weight a component gives each column. PC1 weights the charge half and the discharge half with opposite signs, so it measures the gap between them: as resistance rises with age, charging voltage rides higher and discharge voltage sags lower. The same contrast appeared in both chemistries of the earlier lithium-metal analysis and appears here in a third, LCO. In “Every cycle on PC1–PC2”, cycles move from early to late along PC1, with the four batteries overlapping; PC2 carries '+fmt(100*D.pca.pooled.evr[1],1)+'% of the variance, mostly ripples within a test session.';
  $("perCellCaption").innerHTML='<b>Four separate fits, one loading.</b> Cosine similarity measures how closely two loading curves point the same way (1 = identical); the lowest value between any two batteries is <b>'+fmt(minCosine(),3)+'</b>. CS2_38 finds the same PC1 but orders its cycles by age less cleanly, because its polarisation rises and then recovers during one episode.';
  $("umapCaption").innerHTML='<b>Islands ordered by age, with the batteries mixed.</b> Each point is one cycle. Every island contains cycles from all four batteries, unlike the earlier lithium-metal UMAP, where the chemistries separated. The islands follow test sessions and the partial recovery after each rest. Parameters are n_neighbors = '+integer(D.umap.params.n_neighbors)+', min_dist = '+fmt(D.umap.params.min_dist,1)+', seed = '+integer(D.umap.params.seed)+'.';
  $("splitCallout").innerHTML='<b>Why hold out whole batteries?</b> Neighbouring cycles of one battery are nearly identical. If rows were split at random, every test row would have a near-twin among the training rows. Holding out a whole battery avoids that.';
  $("dqIntro").innerHTML='For each discharge, the charge delivered is read off at fixed voltages, giving Q(V). Subtracting an early reference cycle gives ΔQ(V) = Q<sub>k</sub>(V) − Q<sub>ref</sub>(V), which shows where in the voltage range the battery has lost capacity. Severson and colleagues used the variance of an early ΔQ(V) curve as a lifetime feature across '+integer(FACT.severson_cells)+' lithium-iron-phosphate (LFP) batteries. Here the same feature is computed for these '+integer(CELLS.length)+' LCO batteries.';
  const pooled=D.pca.pooled;
  $("pooledPayloadTable").innerHTML='<thead><tr><th>component</th><th>variance</th><th>η²(battery)</th><th>stored loading</th><th>stored scores</th></tr></thead><tbody>'+[1,2,3,4].map(n=>{const load=pooled["load"+n],scores=pooled["s"+n],eta=pooled.eta2_cell["pc"+n];return '<tr><td>PC'+n+'</td><td class="num">'+fmt(100*pooled.evr[n-1],2)+'%</td><td class="num">'+fmt(eta,3)+'</td><td class="num">'+(load?integer(load.length)+' values · '+arrayRange(load,4):'not stored')+'</td><td class="num">'+(scores?integer(scores.length)+' values · '+arrayRange(scores,3):'not stored')+'</td></tr>'}).join("")+'</tbody>';
  $("pooledRhoTable").innerHTML='<thead><tr><th>battery</th><th>ρ(PC1, cycle)</th><th>ρ(PC1, capacity)</th><th>ρ(PC2, cycle)</th></tr></thead><tbody>'+CELLS.map(c=>{const q=pooled.rho[c];return '<tr><td><span class="cell-dot" style="background:var('+cellToken(c)+')"></span>'+c+'</td><td class="num">'+fmt(q.rho_pc1_cycle,3)+'</td><td class="num">'+fmt(q.rho_pc1_qdis,3)+'</td><td class="num">'+fmt(q.rho_pc2_cycle,3)+'</td></tr>'}).join("")+'</tbody>';
  $("perCellPayloadTable").innerHTML='<thead><tr><th>battery</th><th>variance vector (PC1–PC5)</th><th>PC2 loading</th><th>PC1 scores</th><th>PC2 scores</th></tr></thead><tbody>'+CELLS.map(c=>{const q=D.pca.percell[c];return '<tr><td><span class="cell-dot" style="background:var('+cellToken(c)+')"></span>'+c+'</td><td class="num">'+q.evr.map(v=>fmt(100*v,2)+'%').join(' · ')+'</td><td class="num">'+integer(q.load2.length)+' · '+arrayRange(q.load2,4)+'</td><td class="num">'+integer(q.scores1.length)+' · '+arrayRange(q.scores1,3)+'</td><td class="num">'+integer(q.scores2.length)+' · '+arrayRange(q.scores2,3)+'</td></tr>'}).join("")+'</tbody>';
}
function minCosine(){let out=Infinity;D.pca.cos_sim_load1.forEach((row,a)=>row.forEach((v,b)=>{if(a!==b)out=Math.min(out,Math.abs(v))}));return out}
function arrayRange(a,d=3){const e=PC.extent(a);return fmt(e[0],d)+" … "+fmt(e[1],d)}

function buildConclusions(){
  const P=D.pca.pooled, L=D.pca.loco, d38=D.dq.cells[CELLS[3]];
  $("conclusionIntro").textContent="The main results, most important first.";
  const items=[
    ["One curve-shape direction dominates all four batteries and carries over between them","PCA receives no cycle numbers or capacity, yet its first component orders most of each battery’s life and reappears when PCA is fitted to each battery separately.","PC1 variance = "+pct(P.evr[0])+" · minimum loading cosine = "+fmt(minCosine(),3)],
    ["PCA fitted on three batteries works on the fourth","Components fitted on three batteries reproduce the fourth battery’s own PC1 almost exactly. Holding out whole batteries keeps nearly identical neighbouring cycles out of the test.","agreement with each battery’s own PC1 = "+CELLS.map(c=>fmt(L[c].agree_within,3)).join(" · ")],
    ["PC1 tracks capacity, which PCA never saw","Capacity is computed from the current and never enters X. Three batteries show a strong inverse rank correlation; CS2_38’s is weaker.","ρ(PC1, capacity) = "+CELLS.map(c=>c+" "+fmt(P.rho[c].rho_pc1_qdis,3)).join(" · ")],
    ["PC1 measures polarisation, not age itself","CS2_38’s reversible episode changes the curve shape while capacity keeps fading. That PC1 follows the voltage gap here, not capacity, supports reading it as polarisation.","CS2_38 ρ(PC1, cycle) = "+fmt(L[CELLS[3]].rho_pc1_cycle,3)+" · episode = cycles "+integer(FACT.excursion_start)+"–"+integer(FACT.excursion_end)],
    ["ΔQ(V) grows at low voltage and tracks remaining life within each battery","The difference curves grow most at low voltage, and within each battery their log variance tracks remaining life; the comparison across batteries has four points.","CS2_38 ρ = "+fmt(d38.rho_log10var_remaining,3)+" · n = "+integer(CELLS.length)],
    ["The analysis covers life down to about SOH 0.52","Late cycles with fewer than 64 samples in a half are left out rather than filled in, so the last part of life is not in X.","matrix rows = "+integer(NR)+" · coverage floor ≈ SOH "+fmt(FACT.coverage_soh,2)]
  ];
  $("conclusion-content").innerHTML='<div class="concl">'+items.map(x=>'<div><h4>'+x[0]+'</h4><p>'+x[1]+'</p><p class="num-ev">'+x[2]+'</p></div>').join("")+'</div>';
}

const GLOSS=[
  ["Battery and protocol",[
    ["Battery","One of the four CALCE CS2 test batteries, CS2_35 to CS2_38. Each is a single "+fmt(META.rated_ah,1)+" Ah prismatic cell, so “battery” and “cell” mean the same thing here."],
    ["LCO","Lithium cobalt oxide, the chemistry of these batteries. Its discharge voltage slopes continuously rather than staying on a long flat plateau."],
    ["LFP","Lithium iron phosphate, the flatter-voltage chemistry used in the comparison studies discussed on this page."],
    ["CC charge","Constant-current charging at the protocol’s fixed current until the upper voltage limit is reached."],
    ["CV hold","Constant-voltage charging at the upper voltage limit while current tapers to the cutoff."],
    ["C-rate","Current relative to rated capacity; here the discharge current equals one nominal capacity per hour."],
    ["Capacity","The charge delivered in one discharge, obtained by adding up the current over time. Here it is kept as a label, not used as an input."],
    ["SOH","State of health: the capacity delivered in one discharge divided by the rated capacity, "+fmt(META.rated_ah,1)+" Ah. (The Battery SOH demo divides by a fixed 4,100 A·s, about 1.14 Ah, instead.)"],
    ["CE","Coulombic efficiency: discharged charge relative to charged charge for one cycle; stored as a label."],
    ["EOL80","End of life at 80%: the first cycle from which SOH stays at or below 0.80 for "+META.sustain+" consecutive cycles."],
    ["Session","One exported workbook covering a stretch of testing. Cycle counters restart in each one."],
    ["Polarisation","The charge branch riding higher and the discharge branch lower under load, producing a voltage gap associated with resistance."],
    ["Rest recovery","Partial relaxation of voltage and capacity after idle time, visible as session-aligned sawteeth rather than true rejuvenation."],
    ["Cyclable-lithium inventory","Lithium still available to shuttle during cycling. Its loss shortens the delivered-capacity span."],
    ["Internal resistance","Opposition inside the battery that raises charging voltage and lowers discharging voltage under current."]
  ]],
  ["Rows and transformations",[
    ["Cycle curve","The complete recorded round trip of charge, hold, rest and discharge for one cycle."],
    ["Half-cycle","The behavior-located charge or discharge portion treated separately during time normalization."],
    ["Normalized time","Position from start to end of one half-cycle, independent of its real duration."],
    ["Resampling","Interpolation onto the shared normalized-time columns. Retained rows are downsampled, never upsampled."],
    ["Seam","The fixed boundary between the charge and discharge column blocks in every row."],
    ["Z-score","For each row, subtract its own mean and divide by its own standard deviation, removing level and scale."],
    ["Design matrix X","The sample-by-feature array given to PCA: one retained cycle per row and one normalized-time voltage-shape value per column."],
    ["Feature","A value inside X that the model is allowed to use."],
    ["Label","Context stored beside X, such as cycle, capacity, duration and battery identity, revealed only for evaluation."],
    ["Truncated cycle","A record that contains apparent phases but does not reach the protocol’s termination span."],
    ["Too-few-samples rule","Removes a cycle if either half has fewer than "+integer(SEAM)+" logged samples, too few to fill the "+integer(SEAM)+" columns without inventing points."]
  ]],
  ["Representation and evaluation",[
    ["PCA","Principal component analysis, fitted here only to X to find orthogonal directions of greatest shape covariance."],
    ["Principal component","A weighted direction through the shape columns. PC1 is the leading direction."],
    ["Loading","A column’s weight in a principal component; its sign pattern shows what curve contrast the component measures."],
    ["Score","A row’s coordinate after projection onto a component."],
    ["Explained variance","The share of total shape variance carried by one principal component."],
    ["η²","The share of a component’s variance explained by which battery a cycle came from; used here to check whether PCA on all four batteries mostly separates them."],
    ["Spearman ρ","Rank correlation used to ask whether scores order cycles or capacity without assuming a straight-line relation."],
    ["Cosine similarity","Agreement between loading directions after their arbitrary sign is aligned."],
    ["Leave one battery out","Fit on every row from three batteries and project every row from the fourth."],
    ["UMAP","A nonlinear method that places rows with similar shapes near each other in two dimensions; used here as a second view alongside PCA."],
    ["ΔQ(V)","The delivered-capacity curve at a later cycle minus an early reference curve on a shared voltage grid."],
    ["Log variance","The base-ten logarithm of variance across one ΔQ(V) curve, reducing it to one scalar per cycle."],
    ["Remaining life","Cycles from the current cycle to the sustained EOL80 crossing in the within-battery ΔQ(V) check."]
  ]]
];
function buildGlossary(){
  $("glossary-content").innerHTML='<div class="gloss">'+GLOSS.map(group=>'<section><h3>'+group[0]+'</h3>'+group[1].map(t=>'<div class="term"><b>'+t[0]+'</b><p>'+t[1]+'</p></div>').join("")+'</section>').join("")+'</div>';
}

function buildFooter(){
  const P=D.provenance;
  $("footerSource").textContent="Data © CALCE Battery Research Group, University of Maryland · CS2 prismatic LCO cells · "+fmt(META.rated_ah,1)+" Ah";
  $("footerMethod").textContent="Uses the same method as the earlier lithium-metal curve-shape analysis. The numerical results (computed "+META.generated+") are stored in this page and drawn here.";
  $("footerReproduce").innerHTML='<b>Pipeline.</b> <code>'+esc(FACT.precompute_command)+'</code>, then <code>'+esc(FACT.build_command)+'</code>. Preprocessing locates charge/discharge halves from behavior, requires at least '+integer(SEAM)+' samples in each half, resamples them separately to '+integer(SEAM)+' + '+integer(SEAM)+' columns with seam '+integer(SEAM)+', row-z-scores voltage, validates termination span, and stores capacity/CE/duration/cell/cycle as labels rather than features. The build injects the existing <code>tools/shape_data.json</code>, <code>tools/contract_data.json</code>, provenance card and shared design assets into <code>shape.html</code>. PCA uses full SVD with fixed sign; UMAP alone uses seed '+integer(META.seed)+'. Versions: numpy '+esc(META.versions.numpy)+', pandas '+esc(META.versions.pandas)+', scikit-learn '+esc(META.versions.sklearn)+', umap-learn '+esc(META.versions.umap)+'. URL controls include <code>?theme=dark</code>, <code>?theme=light</code> and <code>?tab=dq</code>.';
}

function addOptions(select,items){select.innerHTML=items.map(x=>'<option value="'+esc(x[0])+'">'+esc(x[1])+'</option>').join("")}
function buildControls(){
  addOptions($("rawCell"),CELLS.map(c=>[c,c]));
  addOptions($("xfExample"),D.xform_examples.map((e,i)=>[i,(i?"late":"early")+" — cycle "+e.cycle+" (SOH "+fmt(e.soh,2)+")"]));
  addOptions($("scoreColor"),[["cycle","cycle number"],["cell","battery"],["soh","SOH"]]);
  addOptions($("umapColor"),[["cycle","cycle number"],["cell","battery"]]);
  addOptions($("evalView"),[["transfer","Shape → age transfer"],["dq","ΔQ(V) remaining-life features"]]);
  addOptions($("holdoutCell"),CELLS.map(c=>[c,"hold out "+c]));
  addOptions($("dqCell"),CELLS.map(c=>[c,c]));
  $("dmRowSlider").max=NR-1;$("dmColSlider").max=NC-1;
  const map={rawCell:"rawCell",xfExample:"xf",scoreColor:"scoreColor",umapColor:"umapColor",evalView:"evalView",holdoutCell:"holdout",dqCell:"dqCell"};
  Object.entries(map).forEach(([id,key])=>$(id).addEventListener("change",e=>VIEW.set({[key]:key==="xf"?Number(e.target.value):e.target.value},{source:id})));
  $("dmRowSlider").addEventListener("input",e=>VIEW.set({row:Number(e.target.value)},{source:"row-slider"}));
  $("dmColSlider").addEventListener("input",e=>VIEW.set({col:Number(e.target.value)},{source:"column-slider"}));
}
function syncControls(s){
  $("rawCell").value=s.rawCell;$("xfExample").value=s.xf;$("scoreColor").value=s.scoreColor;$("umapColor").value=s.umapColor;
  $("evalView").value=s.evalView;$("holdoutCell").value=s.holdout;$("dqCell").value=s.dqCell;
  $("dmRowSlider").value=s.row;$("dmColSlider").value=s.col;
  [["transferView",s.evalView==="transfer"],["dqView",s.evalView==="dq"]].forEach(([id,active])=>{const el=$(id);el.classList.toggle("is-inactive",!active);el.setAttribute("aria-hidden",active?"false":"true")});
}

function niceTicks(a,b,n=5){
  const span=b-a;if(!(span>0))return[a];const raw=span/n,mag=Math.pow(10,Math.floor(Math.log10(raw)));
  const step=[1,2,2.5,5,10].map(v=>v*mag).find(v=>span/v<=n+1)||10*mag,out=[];
  for(let v=Math.ceil(a/step)*step;v<=b+1e-9;v+=step)out.push(Number(v.toFixed(10)));return out;
}
function sizeCanvas(id,height){
  const cv=$(id),box=cv.parentElement,w=Math.max(180,Math.floor(box.getBoundingClientRect().width));
  const g=PC.fit(cv,w,height);return{cv,g,w,h:height};
}
function plotSetup(id,height,xr,yr,pad){
  const p=sizeCanvas(id,height),s=PC.scales(p.cv,xr,yr,pad||{l:52,r:12,t:14,b:52});return{...p,s,box:PC.boxOf(s)};
}
function drawLine(g,s,xs,ys,color,width=2,alpha=1,dash=null){
  g.save();g.strokeStyle=color;g.lineWidth=width;g.lineJoin="round";g.lineCap="round";g.globalAlpha=alpha;if(dash)g.setLineDash(dash);g.beginPath();let started=false;
  for(let i=0;i<xs.length;i++){if(ys[i]==null||!Number.isFinite(ys[i])){started=false;continue}const x=s.x(xs[i]),y=s.y(ys[i]);if(started)g.lineTo(x,y);else{g.moveTo(x,y);started=true}}
  g.stroke();g.restore();
}
function drawPoints(g,s,xs,ys,color,r=4,alpha=.75,selected=-1){
  g.save();for(let i=0;i<xs.length;i++){if(ys[i]==null||!Number.isFinite(ys[i]))continue;const x=s.x(xs[i]),y=s.y(ys[i]);g.globalAlpha=alpha;g.fillStyle=PC.css("--surface-1");g.beginPath();g.arc(x,y,r+1.5,0,Math.PI*2);g.fill();g.fillStyle=typeof color==="function"?color(i):color;g.beginPath();g.arc(x,y,r,0,Math.PI*2);g.fill();if(i===selected){g.globalAlpha=1;g.strokeStyle=PC.css("--text-primary");g.lineWidth=2;g.beginPath();g.arc(x,y,r+5,0,Math.PI*2);g.stroke()}}
  g.restore();
}
function bindPointTip(cv,points,html,radius=24,onClick=null){
  PC.hover(cv,points,{radius,onHit:(i,e)=>PC.tip(html(i),e),onLeave:()=>PC.hideTip(),onClick:onClick?(i,e)=>onClick(i,e):undefined});
}
function cellLegend(host=CELLS){return host.map(c=>'<span><span class="swatch" style="background:var('+cellToken(c)+')"></span>'+c+'</span>').join("")}

function drawFullCycle(){
  const fc=D.full_cycle,t=fc.t_h,ir=fc.i;let ch0=null,cc1=t[0],cv1=t[0],d0=null,d1=t[0];
  for(let i=0;i<ir.length;i++){if(ir[i]>FACT.charge_current_threshold&&ch0==null)ch0=t[i];if(ir[i]>FACT.cc_detection_a)cc1=t[i];if(ir[i]>FACT.charge_current_threshold)cv1=t[i];if(ir[i]<FACT.discharge_current_threshold){if(d0==null)d0=t[i];d1=t[i]}}
  $("fcNote").textContent=fc.cell+", cycle "+fc.cycle+" · SOH "+fmt(fc.soh,2)+" · "+integer(META.protocol.sample_s)+" s sampling";
  [["fcV",fc.v,"Voltage (V)",220],["fcI",fc.i,"Current (A)",150]].forEach(([id,y,yLabel,height])=>{
    const xr=PC.extent(t),base=PC.extent(y),yr=PC.pad10(base),p=plotSetup(id,height,xr,yr,{l:54,r:12,t:20,b:52}),{g,s,box,cv}=p;
    g.fillStyle=PC.css("--accent-soft");g.fillRect(s.x(ch0),box.top,s.x(cv1)-s.x(ch0),box.bottom-box.top);
    g.fillStyle=PC.css("--surface-2");g.fillRect(s.x(d0),box.top,s.x(d1)-s.x(d0),box.bottom-box.top);
    PC.drawAxes(g,box,niceTicks(xr[0],xr[1],6),niceTicks(base[0],base[1],4),s.x,s.y,"Time in cycle (h) →",yLabel,{grid:"y",xFmt:v=>fmt(v,1),yFmt:v=>fmt(v,1)});
    drawLine(g,s,t,y,id==="fcV"?PC.css("--cs2-35"):PC.css("--series-2"));
    if(id==="fcV"){g.font=`600 10px ${FONT}`;g.fillStyle=PC.css("--text-secondary");g.fillText("CC "+fmt(META.protocol.cc_a,2)+" A",s.x(ch0)+5,box.top+13);g.fillText("CV "+fmt(META.protocol.cv_v,1)+" V",s.x(cc1)+5,box.top+13);g.fillText("discharge",s.x(d0)+5,box.top+13)}
    const pts=t.map((v,i)=>[s.x(v),s.y(y[i]),i]);bindPointTip(cv,pts,i=>'<b>t</b> '+fmt(t[i],2)+' h<br><b>V</b> '+fmt(fc.v[i],3)+' V<br><b>I</b> '+fmt(fc.i[i],3)+' A');
  });
}

function drawRaw(sv){
  const cd=D.cells[sv.rawCell],spread=cd.spread,cmax=cd.fade_cycle.at(-1),ramp=PC.rampScale(),colorOf=c=>ramp(.05+.9*c/cmax);
  [["rawVt","t","Time in discharge (h) →"],["rawVq","q","Delivered capacity (Ah) →"]].forEach(([id,key,xLabel])=>{
    let xmax=0;spread.forEach(curve=>{xmax=Math.max(xmax,...curve[key])});const p=plotSetup(id,255,[0,xmax*1.03],[2.65,4.15],{l:52,r:12,t:12,b:52}),{g,s,box,cv}=p;
    PC.drawAxes(g,box,niceTicks(0,xmax,5),[2.8,3.2,3.6,4],s.x,s.y,xLabel,"Voltage (V)",{grid:"y",xFmt:v=>fmt(v,1),yFmt:v=>fmt(v,1)});
    const hits=[];spread.forEach((curve,ci)=>{drawLine(g,s,curve[key],curve.v,colorOf(curve.cycle),curve.in_matrix?2:1,curve.in_matrix?1:.55,curve.in_matrix?null:[4,3]);for(let i=0;i<curve[key].length;i+=4)hits.push([s.x(curve[key][i]),s.y(curve.v[i]),hits.length,{ci,i}])});
    bindPointTip(cv,hits,i=>{const h=hits[i][3],c=spread[h.ci];return '<b>cycle</b> '+c.cycle+'<br><b>SOH</b> '+fmt(c.soh,3)+'<br><b>V</b> '+fmt(c.v[h.i],3)+' V'+(c.in_matrix?'':'<br>excluded: under-resolved')});
  });
  $("rawLegend").innerHTML=spread.map(c=>'<span><span class="swatch" style="background:'+colorOf(c.cycle)+'"></span>cycle '+c.cycle+(c.in_matrix?'':' · not in X')+'</span>').join("");
  const yr=[Math.min(...cd.fade_soh)-.03,Math.max(1.05,Math.max(...cd.fade_soh)+.02)],p=plotSetup("rawFade",185,[0,cmax*1.02],yr,{l:52,r:12,t:18,b:52}),{g,s,box,cv}=p;
  g.fillStyle=PC.css("--accent-soft");let start=null;for(let i=0;i<=cd.fade_cycle.length;i++){const on=i<cd.fade_cycle.length&&cd.fade_in_matrix[i];if(on&&start==null)start=cd.fade_cycle[i];if(!on&&start!=null){g.fillRect(s.x(start),box.top,s.x(cd.fade_cycle[Math.max(0,i-1)])-s.x(start),box.bottom-box.top);start=null}}
  PC.drawAxes(g,box,niceTicks(0,cmax,6),[.6,.8,1],s.x,s.y,"Cycle →","SOH",{grid:"y",yFmt:v=>fmt(v,1)});
  g.strokeStyle=PC.css("--axis");g.lineWidth=1;cd.session_starts.forEach(c=>{g.beginPath();g.moveTo(s.x(c),box.top);g.lineTo(s.x(c),box.top+7);g.stroke()});
  if(cd.eol80){drawLine(g,s,[0,cmax],[.8,.8],PC.css("--critical"),1,1,[4,3]);drawLine(g,s,[cd.eol80,cd.eol80],yr,PC.css("--critical"),1,1,[4,3]);g.font=`600 10px ${FONT}`;g.fillStyle=PC.css("--text-secondary");g.fillText("EOL80 @ "+cd.eol80,s.x(cd.eol80)+5,box.top+13)}
  drawLine(g,s,cd.fade_cycle,cd.fade_soh,cellColor(sv.rawCell),2);drawPoints(g,s,spread.map(c=>c.cycle),spread.map(c=>c.soh),i=>colorOf(spread[i].cycle),4,1);
  const hits=cd.fade_cycle.map((c,i)=>[s.x(c),s.y(cd.fade_soh[i]),i]);bindPointTip(cv,hits,i=>'<b>cycle</b> '+cd.fade_cycle[i]+'<br><b>SOH</b> '+fmt(cd.fade_soh[i],3)+(cd.fade_in_matrix[i]?'':'<br>not in X'));
  $("rawCaption").innerHTML='<b>The curve shrinks and sags.</b> Later discharges are shorter, and the sloping middle sits lower. In V(Q) the curves separate first at low voltage, the region that ΔQ(V) measures later on this page. In “SOH over life”, ticks mark the start of each test session; SOH dips and partly recovers around them, so it falls steadily only on average. Dashed late curves are complete but have fewer than '+integer(SEAM)+' samples, so they are left out of X.';
  $("rawTwin").innerHTML='<thead><tr><th>cycle</th><th>SOH</th><th>raw points</th><th>in X</th></tr></thead><tbody>'+spread.map(c=>'<tr><td class="num">'+c.cycle+'</td><td class="num">'+fmt(c.soh,4)+'</td><td class="num">'+c.v.length+'</td><td>'+(c.in_matrix?'yes':'no, too few samples')+'</td></tr>').join("")+'</tbody>';
}

function drawXform(sv){
  const ex=D.xform_examples[sv.xf],ri=MX.cycle.findIndex((c,i)=>c===ex.cycle&&MX.cell[i]===CELLS.indexOf(ex.cell));
  const xr=PC.extent(ex.t_h),p=plotSetup("xfReal",230,xr,[2.6,4.3],{l:52,r:12,t:14,b:52}),{g,s,box,cv}=p;
  g.fillStyle=PC.css("--accent-soft");g.fillRect(s.x(ex.ch_span_h[0]),box.top,s.x(ex.ch_span_h[1])-s.x(ex.ch_span_h[0]),box.bottom-box.top);
  g.fillStyle=PC.css("--surface-2");g.fillRect(s.x(ex.dis_span_h[0]),box.top,s.x(ex.dis_span_h[1])-s.x(ex.dis_span_h[0]),box.bottom-box.top);
  PC.drawAxes(g,box,niceTicks(xr[0],xr[1],5),[2.8,3.2,3.6,4],s.x,s.y,"Real time (h) →","Voltage (V)",{grid:"y",xFmt:v=>fmt(v,1),yFmt:v=>fmt(v,1)});drawLine(g,s,ex.t_h,ex.v,cellColor(ex.cell));
  bindPointTip(cv,ex.t_h.map((t,i)=>[s.x(t),s.y(ex.v[i]),i]),i=>'<b>time</b> '+fmt(ex.t_h[i],3)+' h<br><b>voltage</b> '+fmt(ex.v[i],3)+' V');
  [["xfGrid",j=>voltAt(ri,j),"Voltage (V)"],["xfZ",j=>zAt(ri,j),"Row z-score"]].forEach(([id,get,yLabel])=>{
    const vals=Array.from({length:NC},(_,j)=>get(j)),yr=PC.pad10(PC.extent(vals)),q=plotSetup(id,230,[0,NC-1],yr,{l:52,r:12,t:14,b:52}),{g,s,box,cv}=q;
    PC.drawAxes(g,box,[0,Math.floor(SEAM/2),SEAM,SEAM+Math.floor(SEAM/2),NC-1],niceTicks(yr[0],yr[1],4),s.x,s.y,"Matrix column →",yLabel,{grid:"y",yFmt:v=>fmt(v,yLabel==="Voltage (V)"?1:0)});drawLine(g,s,[SEAM,SEAM],yr,PC.css("--axis"),1,1,[4,3]);drawLine(g,s,vals.map((_,j)=>j),vals,PC.css("--series-2"));
    bindPointTip(cv,vals.map((v,j)=>[s.x(j),s.y(v),j]),j=>'<b>column</b> '+j+' · '+(j<SEAM?'charge':'discharge')+'<br><b>'+yLabel+'</b> '+fmt(vals[j],3));
  });
  const ch=ex.ch_span_h[1]-ex.ch_span_h[0],dis=ex.dis_span_h[1]-ex.dis_span_h[0];
  $("xfCaption").innerHTML='<b>The same recipe at every age.</b> '+ex.cell+' cycle '+ex.cycle+' has SOH '+fmt(ex.soh,2)+', charge duration '+fmt(ch,2)+' h and discharge duration '+fmt(dis,2)+' h. After resampling, each half has exactly '+integer(SEAM)+' columns. Standardising removes the mean '+fmt(MX.v_mean[ri],3)+' V and the spread '+fmt(MX.v_std[ri],3)+' V; the capacity '+fmt(MX.q_dis[ri],3)+' Ah and CE '+fmt(MX.ce[ri],3)+' are kept as labels.';
}

let heatOff=null,heatTheme="";
function buildHeat(){
  const theme=document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme")||String(PC.isDark()),tag=theme+PC.css("--div-mid");if(heatOff&&heatTheme===tag)return;
  heatTheme=tag;heatOff=document.createElement("canvas");heatOff.width=NC;heatOff.height=NR;const g=heatOff.getContext("2d"),img=g.createImageData(NC,NR),div=PC.divScale();
  for(let i=0;i<NR;i++)for(let j=0;j<NC;j++){const c=String(div(zAt(i,j)/FACT.heat_z_limit)).match(/\d+/g),o=(i*NC+j)*4;img.data[o]=Number(c[0]);img.data[o+1]=Number(c[1]);img.data[o+2]=Number(c[2]);img.data[o+3]=255}g.putImageData(img,0,0);
}
let heatBound=false;
function drawMatrix(sv){
  buildHeat();const i=sv.row,j=sv.col,k=MX.cell[i],cell=CELLS[k],p=sizeCanvas("mxHeat",440),{g,w,h,cv}=p,pad={l:66,r:12,t:24,b:40},box={left:pad.l,right:w-pad.r,top:pad.t,bottom:h-pad.b};
  g.imageSmoothingEnabled=true;g.drawImage(heatOff,box.left,box.top,box.right-box.left,box.bottom-box.top);
  const rx=r=>box.top+(r+.5)/NR*(box.bottom-box.top),cx=c=>box.left+(c+.5)/NC*(box.right-box.left);
  g.font=`10px ${FONT}`;let acc=0;CELLS.forEach((c,ci)=>{const n=cellRows[ci].length;if(ci){g.strokeStyle=PC.css("--surface-1");g.lineWidth=2;g.beginPath();g.moveTo(box.left,rx(acc));g.lineTo(box.right,rx(acc));g.stroke()}g.save();g.fillStyle=PC.css("--text-secondary");g.translate(box.left-48,rx(acc+n/2)+18);g.rotate(-Math.PI/2);g.fillText(c,0,0);g.restore();acc+=n});
  g.strokeStyle=PC.css("--axis");g.lineWidth=1;g.setLineDash([4,3]);g.beginPath();g.moveTo(cx(SEAM),box.top);g.lineTo(cx(SEAM),box.bottom);g.stroke();g.setLineDash([]);g.fillStyle=PC.css("--text-secondary");g.font=`600 10px ${FONT}`;g.fillText("charge",box.left+5,box.top-7);g.fillText("discharge",cx(SEAM)+5,box.top-7);g.fillText("column j →",box.right-62,box.bottom+18);
  g.strokeStyle=PC.css("--matrix-row");g.lineWidth=2;g.beginPath();g.moveTo(box.left,rx(i));g.lineTo(box.right,rx(i));g.stroke();g.strokeStyle=PC.css("--matrix-column");g.beginPath();g.moveTo(cx(j),box.top);g.lineTo(cx(j),box.bottom);g.stroke();g.fillStyle=PC.css("--matrix-cell");g.beginPath();g.arc(cx(j),rx(i),4,0,Math.PI*2);g.fill();
  const pick=(x,y)=>x<box.left||x>box.right||y<box.top||y>box.bottom?null:[Math.max(0,Math.min(NR-1,Math.floor((y-box.top)/(box.bottom-box.top)*NR))),Math.max(0,Math.min(NC-1,Math.floor((x-box.left)/(box.right-box.left)*NC)))];
  cv.__matrixPick=pick;if(!heatBound){heatBound=true;cv.addEventListener("pointermove",e=>{const r=cv.getBoundingClientRect(),q=cv.__matrixPick(e.clientX-r.left,e.clientY-r.top);if(!q){PC.hideTip();return}PC.tip('<b>row</b> '+q[0]+' · '+CELLS[MX.cell[q[0]]]+' cycle '+MX.cycle[q[0]]+'<br><b>column</b> '+q[1]+' · '+(q[1]<SEAM?'charge':'discharge')+'<br><b>x[i,j]</b> '+fmt(zAt(q[0],q[1]),2)+' z · '+fmt(voltAt(q[0],q[1]),3)+' V',e)});cv.addEventListener("pointerleave",()=>PC.hideTip());cv.addEventListener("click",e=>{const r=cv.getBoundingClientRect(),q=cv.__matrixPick(e.clientX-r.left,e.clientY-r.top);if(q)VIEW.set({row:q[0],col:q[1]},{source:"matrix"})})}
  const vals=Array.from({length:NC},(_,q)=>voltAt(i,q)),yr=PC.pad10(PC.extent(vals)),rplot=plotSetup("mxRow",190,[0,NC-1],yr,{l:48,r:10,t:12,b:48});
  PC.drawAxes(rplot.g,rplot.box,[0,SEAM,NC-1],niceTicks(yr[0],yr[1],4),rplot.s.x,rplot.s.y,"Matrix column →","Voltage (V)",{grid:"y",yFmt:v=>fmt(v,1)});drawLine(rplot.g,rplot.s,[SEAM,SEAM],yr,PC.css("--axis"),1,1,[4,3]);drawLine(rplot.g,rplot.s,vals.map((_,q)=>q),vals,PC.css("--matrix-row"));drawPoints(rplot.g,rplot.s,[j],[vals[j]],PC.css("--matrix-cell"),4,1);bindPointTip(rplot.cv,vals.map((v,q)=>[rplot.s.x(q),rplot.s.y(v),q]),q=>'<b>column</b> '+q+'<br><b>voltage</b> '+fmt(vals[q],3)+' V<br><b>z</b> '+fmt(zAt(i,q),2));
  let maxCycle=0;CELLS.forEach(c=>maxCycle=Math.max(maxCycle,D.cells[c].fade_cycle.at(-1)));const all=Array.from({length:NR},(_,r)=>zAt(r,j)),cr=PC.pad10(PC.extent(all)),cplot=plotSetup("mxColumn",190,[0,maxCycle],cr,{l:48,r:10,t:12,b:48});
  PC.drawAxes(cplot.g,cplot.box,niceTicks(0,maxCycle,5),niceTicks(cr[0],cr[1],4),cplot.s.x,cplot.s.y,"Cycle →","Row z-score",{grid:"y",yFmt:v=>fmt(v,1)});const hits=[];CELLS.forEach((c,ci)=>{const rows=cellRows[ci],xs=rows.map(r=>MX.cycle[r]),ys=rows.map(r=>zAt(r,j));drawPoints(cplot.g,cplot.s,xs,ys,cellColor(c),2.5,ci===k?.8:.3);rows.forEach((r,q)=>{if(q%3===0)hits.push([cplot.s.x(xs[q]),cplot.s.y(ys[q]),hits.length,{r}])})});drawPoints(cplot.g,cplot.s,[MX.cycle[i]],[zAt(i,j)],PC.css("--matrix-cell"),4,1);bindPointTip(cplot.cv,hits,q=>{const r=hits[q][3].r;return '<b>'+CELLS[MX.cell[r]]+'</b> cycle '+MX.cycle[r]+'<br><b>z</b> '+fmt(zAt(r,j),2)});
  const pos=Math.round((j<SEAM?j/(SEAM-1):(j-SEAM)/(SEAM-1))*100);
  $("dmRowOut").value=cell+" · cycle "+MX.cycle[i];$("dmColOut").value="j = "+j;$("dmCellReadout").innerHTML='<b>x['+i+','+j+']</b> = '+fmt(zAt(i,j),2)+' z = '+fmt(voltAt(i,j),3)+' V';
  $("dmRowReadout").innerHTML='<b>X['+i+',:]</b> → '+cell+', cycle '+MX.cycle[i]+'; reconstructed with v_mean '+fmt(MX.v_mean[i],3)+' V and v_std '+fmt(MX.v_std[i],3)+' V.';
  $("dmColumnReadout").innerHTML='<b>X[:,'+j+']</b> → '+pos+'% through normalized '+(j<SEAM?'charge':'discharge')+' time across '+integer(NR)+' rows.';
  buildMatrixTableState(sv);buildLabelTable(i);if(dmRowsBinding)dmRowsBinding.refresh();if(dmColsBinding)dmColsBinding.refresh();
}

let dmRowsBinding=null,dmColsBinding=null;
function buildMatrixTables(){
  $("dmRowsTable").querySelector("tbody").innerHTML=Array.from({length:NR},(_,i)=>'<tr data-key="'+i+'"><td class="num">'+i+'</td><td>'+CELLS[MX.cell[i]]+'</td><td class="num">'+MX.cycle[i]+'</td><td class="num">'+fmt(MX.soh[i],3)+'</td><td class="num">'+fmt(MX.q_dis[i],3)+'</td></tr>').join("");
  dmRowsBinding=PC.bindTableRows("#dmRowsTable",{key:r=>Number(r.dataset.key),selected:()=>VIEW.get().row,onSelect:key=>VIEW.set({row:key},{source:"row-table"})});
  dmColsBinding=PC.bindTableRows("#dmColumnsTable",{
    key:r=>Number(r.dataset.key),selected:()=>VIEW.get().col,
    onSelect:(key,_index,_row,event)=>{
      VIEW.set({col:key},{source:"column-table"});
      /* Changing a column rebuilds this 128-row tbody.  Preserve keyboard
         position on the replacement row after Enter/Space activation. */
      if(event&&event.type==="keydown")requestAnimationFrame(()=>{
        const table=$("dmColumnsTable");
        const replacement=[...table.querySelectorAll("tbody tr")].find(row=>Number(row.dataset.key)===Number(key));
        if(replacement){replacement.tabIndex=0;replacement.focus()}
      });
    }
  });
}
function buildMatrixTableState(sv){
  const i=sv.row;$("dmColumnsTable").querySelector("tbody").innerHTML=Array.from({length:NC},(_,j)=>{const pos=Math.round((j<SEAM?j/(SEAM-1):(j-SEAM)/(SEAM-1))*100);return '<tr data-key="'+j+'"><td class="num">'+j+'</td><td>'+(j<SEAM?'charge':'discharge')+'</td><td class="num">'+pos+'%</td><td class="num">'+fmt(zAt(i,j),2)+'</td><td class="num">'+fmt(voltAt(i,j),3)+'</td></tr>'}).join("");
}
function buildLabelTable(i){
  const rows=[["battery",CELLS[MX.cell[i]]],["cycle",MX.cycle[i]],["q_dis (Ah)",fmt(MX.q_dis[i],3)],["SOH",fmt(MX.soh[i],3)],["CE",fmt(MX.ce[i],3)],["charge dur (h)",fmt(MX.dur_ch_h[i],2)],["discharge dur (h)",fmt(MX.dur_dis_h[i],2)],["v_mean (V)",fmt(MX.v_mean[i],3)],["v_std (V)",fmt(MX.v_std[i],3)],["v_ptp (V)",fmt(MX.v_ptp[i],3)],["raw pts (min half)",MX.n_min[i]]];
  $("mxLabelTable").innerHTML='<thead><tr>'+rows.map(r=>'<th>'+r[0]+'</th>').join("")+'</tr></thead><tbody><tr>'+rows.map(r=>'<td>'+r[1]+'</td>').join("")+'</tr></tbody>';
}

function scoreColorFor(sv,r,ramp){
  const c=CELLS[MX.cell[r]];
  if(sv.scoreColor==="cell")return cellColor(c);
  if(sv.scoreColor==="soh")return ramp(Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(MX.soh[r]-FACT.soh_color_min)/(FACT.soh_color_max-FACT.soh_color_min))));
  return ramp(.05+.9*MX.cycle[r]/D.cells[c].fade_cycle.at(-1));
}
function drawPooled(sv){
  const P=D.pca.pooled,ramp=PC.rampScale();
  {
    const p=plotSetup("scree",230,[.4,P.evr.length+.6],[0,1],{l:54,r:10,t:20,b:48}),{g,s,box,cv}=p,pts=[];
    PC.drawAxes(g,box,Array.from({length:P.evr.length},(_,i)=>i+1),[0,.25,.5,.75,1],s.x,s.y,"Principal component →","Variance explained",{grid:"y",xFmt:v=>"PC"+v,yFmt:v=>fmt(100*v,0)+"%"});
    P.evr.forEach((v,i)=>{const x0=s.x(i+.65),x1=s.x(i+1.35),y=s.y(v);g.fillStyle=PC.css("--series-1");g.beginPath();g.roundRect(x0,y,x1-x0,box.bottom-y,[4,4,0,0]);g.fill();pts.push([(x0+x1)/2,y,i]);if(i<3){g.font=`600 10px ${FONT}`;g.fillStyle=PC.css("--text-secondary");g.textAlign="center";g.fillText(fmt(100*v,1)+"%",(x0+x1)/2,y-6);g.textAlign="start"}});
    bindPointTip(cv,pts,i=>'<b>PC'+(i+1)+'</b><br><b>variance</b> '+fmt(100*P.evr[i],2)+'%');
  }
  {
    const yr=PC.pad10(PC.extent(P.load1.concat(P.load2))),p=plotSetup("loadPooled",230,[0,NC-1],yr,{l:54,r:10,t:16,b:48}),{g,s,box,cv}=p;
    PC.drawAxes(g,box,[0,Math.floor(SEAM/2),SEAM,SEAM+Math.floor(SEAM/2),NC-1],niceTicks(yr[0],yr[1],4),s.x,s.y,"Matrix column →","Loading",{grid:"y",yFmt:v=>fmt(v,2)});drawLine(g,s,[0,NC-1],[0,0],PC.css("--axis"),1);drawLine(g,s,[SEAM,SEAM],yr,PC.css("--axis"),1,1,[4,3]);drawLine(g,s,P.load1.map((_,i)=>i),P.load1,PC.css("--series-1"));drawLine(g,s,P.load2.map((_,i)=>i),P.load2,PC.css("--series-2"));
    const pts=[];for(let j=0;j<NC;j++){pts.push([s.x(j),s.y(P.load1[j]),j]);pts.push([s.x(j),s.y(P.load2[j]),NC+j])}bindPointTip(cv,pts,q=>{const pc=q>=NC?2:1,j=q%NC,arr=pc===1?P.load1:P.load2;return '<b>PC'+pc+' column '+j+'</b><br><b>loading</b> '+fmt(arr[j],4)+'<br>'+(j<SEAM?'charge':'discharge')+' half'});
  }
  {
    const xr=PC.pad10(PC.extent(P.s1)),yr=PC.pad10(PC.extent(P.s2)),p=plotSetup("scores",230,xr,yr,{l:52,r:10,t:16,b:50}),{g,s,box,cv}=p;
    PC.drawAxes(g,box,niceTicks(xr[0],xr[1],5),niceTicks(yr[0],yr[1],4),s.x,s.y,"PC1 ("+fmt(100*P.evr[0],1)+"%) →","PC2 ("+fmt(100*P.evr[1],1)+"%)",{grid:"both",xFmt:v=>fmt(v,0),yFmt:v=>fmt(v,0)});
    const pts=[];for(let r=0;r<NR;r++){const x=s.x(P.s1[r]),y=s.y(P.s2[r]);g.globalAlpha=.42;g.fillStyle=PC.css("--surface-1");g.beginPath();g.arc(x,y,5.5,0,Math.PI*2);g.fill();g.fillStyle=scoreColorFor(sv,r,ramp);g.beginPath();g.arc(x,y,4,0,Math.PI*2);g.fill();pts.push([x,y,r])}g.globalAlpha=1;
    const r=sv.row;g.strokeStyle=PC.css("--text-primary");g.lineWidth=2;g.beginPath();g.arc(s.x(P.s1[r]),s.y(P.s2[r]),9,0,Math.PI*2);g.stroke();
    bindPointTip(cv,pts,r=>'<b>'+CELLS[MX.cell[r]]+'</b> cycle '+MX.cycle[r]+'<br><b>SOH</b> '+fmt(MX.soh[r],3)+'<br><b>PC1</b> '+fmt(P.s1[r],2)+'<br><b>PC2</b> '+fmt(P.s2[r],2),24,r=>VIEW.set({row:r},{source:"scores"}));
    $("scoresLegend").innerHTML=sv.scoreColor==="cell"?cellLegend():'<span class="ramp-wrap"><span class="rampbar"></span><span class="rampends"><span>'+(sv.scoreColor==="soh"?'lower SOH':'early cycle')+'</span><span>'+(sv.scoreColor==="soh"?'higher SOH':'late cycle')+'</span></span></span>';
  }
}

function drawPerCell(){
  let lo=Infinity,hi=-Infinity;CELLS.forEach(c=>{const e=PC.extent(D.pca.percell[c].load1);lo=Math.min(lo,e[0]);hi=Math.max(hi,e[1])});const yr=PC.pad10([lo,hi]),p=plotSetup("loadCells",245,[0,NC-1],yr,{l:54,r:10,t:16,b:50}),{g,s,box,cv}=p;
  PC.drawAxes(g,box,[0,Math.floor(SEAM/2),SEAM,SEAM+Math.floor(SEAM/2),NC-1],niceTicks(yr[0],yr[1],4),s.x,s.y,"Matrix column →","PC1 loading",{grid:"y",yFmt:v=>fmt(v,2)});drawLine(g,s,[0,NC-1],[0,0],PC.css("--axis"),1);drawLine(g,s,[SEAM,SEAM],yr,PC.css("--axis"),1,1,[4,3]);
  const pts=[];CELLS.forEach((c,ci)=>{const a=D.pca.percell[c].load1;drawLine(g,s,a.map((_,j)=>j),a,cellColor(c));for(let j=0;j<NC;j+=2)pts.push([s.x(j),s.y(a[j]),pts.length,{c,j}])});bindPointTip(cv,pts,i=>{const h=pts[i][3];return '<b>'+h.c+'</b> column '+h.j+'<br><b>PC1 loading</b> '+fmt(D.pca.percell[h.c].load1[h.j],4)});
  $("loadCellsLegend").innerHTML=cellLegend()+'<span>dashed line = switch from charge to discharge</span>';
  $("perCellTable").innerHTML='<thead><tr><th>battery (own PCA)</th><th>PC1 variance</th><th>ρ(PC1, cycle)</th><th>ρ(PC1, capacity)</th></tr></thead><tbody>'+CELLS.map(c=>{const q=D.pca.percell[c],weak=Math.abs(q.rho_pc1_cycle)<=FACT.strong_rank_threshold;return '<tr><td><span class="cell-dot" style="background:var('+cellToken(c)+')"></span>'+c+'</td><td class="num">'+fmt(100*q.evr[0],1)+'%</td><td class="num '+(weak?'bad':'good')+'">'+fmt(q.rho_pc1_cycle,3)+(weak?' *':'')+'</td><td class="num">'+fmt(q.rho_pc1_qdis,3)+'</td></tr>'}).join("")+'<tr><td colspan="4">* Same loading; this battery also has a reversible episode unrelated to ageing (see Fig 9).</td></tr></tbody>';
}

function drawUmap(sv){
  const U=D.umap,xr=PC.pad10(PC.extent(U.x)),yr=PC.pad10(PC.extent(U.y)),p=plotSetup("umapPlot",300,xr,yr,{l:52,r:12,t:16,b:50}),{g,s,box,cv}=p,ramp=PC.rampScale();
  PC.drawAxes(g,box,niceTicks(xr[0],xr[1],5),niceTicks(yr[0],yr[1],5),s.x,s.y,"UMAP-1 →","UMAP-2",{grid:"both",xFmt:v=>fmt(v,0),yFmt:v=>fmt(v,0)});const pts=[];
  for(let r=0;r<NR;r++){const c=CELLS[MX.cell[r]],color=sv.umapColor==="cell"?cellColor(c):ramp(.05+.9*MX.cycle[r]/D.cells[c].fade_cycle.at(-1)),x=s.x(U.x[r]),y=s.y(U.y[r]);g.globalAlpha=.42;g.fillStyle=PC.css("--surface-1");g.beginPath();g.arc(x,y,5.5,0,Math.PI*2);g.fill();g.fillStyle=color;g.beginPath();g.arc(x,y,4,0,Math.PI*2);g.fill();pts.push([x,y,r])}g.globalAlpha=1;const r=sv.row;g.strokeStyle=PC.css("--text-primary");g.lineWidth=2;g.beginPath();g.arc(s.x(U.x[r]),s.y(U.y[r]),9,0,Math.PI*2);g.stroke();
  bindPointTip(cv,pts,r=>'<b>'+CELLS[MX.cell[r]]+'</b> cycle '+MX.cycle[r]+'<br><b>UMAP-1</b> '+fmt(U.x[r],2)+'<br><b>UMAP-2</b> '+fmt(U.y[r],2),24,r=>VIEW.set({row:r},{source:"umap"}));
}

function drawLoco(sv){
  const cell=sv.holdout,k=CELLS.indexOf(cell),L=D.pca.loco[cell],rows=cellRows[k],cyc=rows.map(r=>MX.cycle[r]),xr=[0,Math.max(...cyc)*1.02],yr=PC.pad10(PC.extent(L.scores1)),p=plotSetup("locoPlot",300,xr,yr,{l:58,r:12,t:20,b:54}),{g,s,box,cv}=p;
  if(cell===CELLS[3]){g.fillStyle=PC.css("--surface-2");g.fillRect(s.x(FACT.excursion_start),box.top,s.x(FACT.excursion_end)-s.x(FACT.excursion_start),box.bottom-box.top);g.font=`600 10px ${FONT}`;g.fillStyle=PC.css("--text-secondary");g.fillText("reversible polarisation episode",s.x(FACT.excursion_start)+5,box.top+14)}
  PC.drawAxes(g,box,niceTicks(0,Math.max(...cyc),6),niceTicks(yr[0],yr[1],5),s.x,s.y,"Cycle number (used only for checking) →","Projected PC1",{grid:"y",yFmt:v=>fmt(v,0)});g.strokeStyle=PC.css("--axis");D.cells[cell].session_starts.forEach(c=>{g.beginPath();g.moveTo(s.x(c),box.bottom-7);g.lineTo(s.x(c),box.bottom);g.stroke()});drawPoints(g,s,cyc,L.scores1,cellColor(cell),4,.55);const pts=rows.map((r,i)=>[s.x(cyc[i]),s.y(L.scores1[i]),i]);bindPointTip(cv,pts,i=>'<b>'+cell+'</b> cycle '+cyc[i]+'<br><b>projected PC1</b> '+fmt(L.scores1[i],2)+'<br><b>SOH</b> '+fmt(MX.soh[rows[i]],3));
  $("locoLegend").innerHTML='<span><span class="swatch" style="background:var('+cellToken(cell)+')"></span>'+cell+' projected from the other three</span><span>ρ with cycle <b>'+fmt(L.rho_pc1_cycle,3)+'</b></span><span>ρ with capacity <b>'+fmt(L.rho_pc1_qdis,3)+'</b></span>';
  $("locoTable").innerHTML='<thead><tr><th>held-out battery</th><th>PC1 variance (fit on the other three)</th><th>ρ(PC1, cycle)</th><th>ρ(PC1, capacity)</th><th>|ρ| with its own PC1</th></tr></thead><tbody>'+CELLS.map(c=>{const q=D.pca.loco[c];return '<tr'+(c===cell?' style="background:var(--accent-soft)"':'')+'><td><span class="cell-dot" style="background:var('+cellToken(c)+')"></span>'+c+'</td><td class="num">'+fmt(100*q.evr1_fit,2)+'%</td><td class="num">'+fmt(q.rho_pc1_cycle,3)+'</td><td class="num">'+fmt(q.rho_pc1_qdis,3)+'</td><td class="num good">'+fmt(q.agree_within,3)+'</td></tr>'}).join("")+'</tbody>';
  $("locoCaption").innerHTML='Each point is one cycle of the held-out battery: its PC1 score against its cycle number. Ticks on the horizontal axis mark the start of each test session. '+(cell===CELLS[3]?'<b>CS2_38 has a reversible episode.</b> During cycles '+integer(FACT.excursion_start)+'–'+integer(FACT.excursion_end)+', its discharge voltage sits about '+integer(FACT.excursion_discharge_mv)+' mV lower and its charge voltage about '+integer(FACT.excursion_charge_mv)+' mV higher, then relaxes back, while capacity keeps falling at its usual rate. PC1 follows this voltage change, so ρ with cycle drops to '+fmt(L.rho_pc1_cycle,2)+', against '+fmt(FACT.other_loco_low,2)+'–'+fmt(FACT.other_loco_high,2)+' for the other batteries. The projection still works; PC1 tracks polarisation rather than age itself.':'<b>A battery the fit never saw.</b> Only '+cell+'’s cycles are plotted; PCA was fitted on the other three batteries. The sawtooth pattern lines up with the test sessions: it is the partial recovery after each rest, seen in the shape score.');
}

function drawPc1Q(sv){
  const P=D.pca.pooled,xr=PC.pad10(PC.extent(MX.q_dis)),yr=PC.pad10(PC.extent(P.s1)),p=plotSetup("pc1qPlot",300,xr,yr,{l:58,r:12,t:16,b:54}),{g,s,box,cv}=p;
  PC.drawAxes(g,box,niceTicks(xr[0],xr[1],5),niceTicks(yr[0],yr[1],5),s.x,s.y,"Discharge capacity (Ah), not an input →","Pooled PC1",{grid:"both",xFmt:v=>fmt(v,1),yFmt:v=>fmt(v,0)});const pts=[];
  for(let r=0;r<NR;r++){const x=s.x(MX.q_dis[r]),y=s.y(P.s1[r]);g.globalAlpha=.4;g.fillStyle=PC.css("--surface-1");g.beginPath();g.arc(x,y,5.5,0,Math.PI*2);g.fill();g.fillStyle=cellColor(CELLS[MX.cell[r]]);g.beginPath();g.arc(x,y,4,0,Math.PI*2);g.fill();pts.push([x,y,r])}g.globalAlpha=1;const r=sv.row;g.strokeStyle=PC.css("--text-primary");g.lineWidth=2;g.beginPath();g.arc(s.x(MX.q_dis[r]),s.y(P.s1[r]),9,0,Math.PI*2);g.stroke();bindPointTip(cv,pts,r=>'<b>'+CELLS[MX.cell[r]]+'</b> cycle '+MX.cycle[r]+'<br><b>capacity</b> '+fmt(MX.q_dis[r],3)+' Ah<br><b>PC1</b> '+fmt(P.s1[r],2),24,r=>VIEW.set({row:r},{source:"capacity"}));
  const three=CELLS.slice(0,3).map(c=>fmt(P.rho[c].rho_pc1_qdis,2)).join(", "),last=P.rho[CELLS[3]].rho_pc1_qdis;
  $("pc1qCaption").innerHTML='<b>Shape tracks capacity.</b> Capacity was computed from the current and never entered X, and standardising each row also removed the voltage level. Even so, the rank correlation ρ between PC1 and capacity (−1 means a perfectly opposite ordering) is '+three+' for the first three batteries. '+CELLS[3]+' reaches only '+fmt(last,2)+', because its temporary polarisation episode moves PC1 while capacity stays on trend. PC1 measures the gap between charge and discharge voltage, which ageing usually, but not always, widens steadily.';
}

function drawDq(sv){
  const cell=sv.dqCell,k=CELLS.indexOf(cell),Q=D.dq.cells[cell],ramp=PC.rampScale(),cmax=Q.traj_cycle.at(-1),colorOf=c=>ramp(.05+.9*c/cmax);
  {
    let lo=0,hi=0;Q.curves.forEach(c=>{const e=PC.extent(c.dq);lo=Math.min(lo,e[0]);hi=Math.max(hi,e[1])});const yr=PC.pad10([lo,hi]),p=plotSetup("dqCurves",255,[D.dq.grid_v0,FACT.dq_display_vmax],yr,{l:58,r:10,t:16,b:52}),{g,s,box,cv}=p,hits=[];
    PC.drawAxes(g,box,[2.8,3.1,3.4,3.7,4],niceTicks(yr[0],yr[1],4),s.x,s.y,"Voltage (V) →","ΔQ (Ah)",{grid:"y",xFmt:v=>fmt(v,1),yFmt:v=>fmt(v,1)});drawLine(g,s,[D.dq.grid_v0,FACT.dq_display_vmax],[0,0],PC.css("--axis"),1);
    Q.curves.forEach((c,ci)=>{const xs=c.dq.map((_,i)=>D.dq.grid_v0+i*(FACT.dq_display_vmax-D.dq.grid_v0)/(c.dq.length-1));drawLine(g,s,xs,c.dq,colorOf(c.cycle));for(let i=0;i<xs.length;i+=3)hits.push([s.x(xs[i]),s.y(c.dq[i]),hits.length,{ci,i,x:xs[i]}])});bindPointTip(cv,hits,i=>{const h=hits[i][3],c=Q.curves[h.ci];return '<b>cycle '+c.cycle+' − '+Q.ref_cycle+'</b><br><b>SOH</b> '+fmt(c.soh,3)+'<br><b>voltage</b> '+fmt(h.x,2)+' V<br><b>ΔQ</b> '+fmt(c.dq[h.i],3)+' Ah'});$("dqLegend").innerHTML=Q.curves.map(c=>'<span><span class="swatch" style="background:'+colorOf(c.cycle)+'"></span>'+c.cycle+' · SOH '+fmt(c.soh,2)+'</span>').join("")+'<span>reference '+Q.ref_cycle+'</span>';
  }
  {
    const vals=Q.traj_log10var.filter(v=>v!=null),yr=PC.pad10(PC.extent(vals)),p=plotSetup("dqTrajectory",255,[0,cmax*1.02],yr,{l:54,r:10,t:16,b:52}),{g,s,box,cv}=p;
    PC.drawAxes(g,box,niceTicks(0,cmax,5),niceTicks(yr[0],yr[1],5),s.x,s.y,"Cycle →","log₁₀ variance",{grid:"y",yFmt:v=>fmt(v,1)});if(Q.eol80){drawLine(g,s,[Q.eol80,Q.eol80],yr,PC.css("--critical"),1,1,[4,3]);g.font=`600 10px ${FONT}`;g.fillStyle=PC.css("--text-secondary");g.fillText("EOL80",s.x(Q.eol80)+4,box.top+13)}drawPoints(g,s,Q.traj_cycle,Q.traj_log10var,cellColor(cell),4,.5);const pts=Q.traj_cycle.map((c,i)=>[s.x(c),Q.traj_log10var[i]==null?-999:s.y(Q.traj_log10var[i]),i]);bindPointTip(cv,pts,i=>'<b>cycle</b> '+Q.traj_cycle[i]+'<br><b>log₁₀ variance</b> '+fmt(Q.traj_log10var[i]||0,2)+(Q.eol80?'<br><b>remaining life</b> '+(Q.eol80-Q.traj_cycle[i])+' cycles':''));
  }
  {
    const S=D.dq.severson,xr=PC.pad10(PC.extent(S.var_100_10)),yr=PC.pad10(PC.extent(S.life)),p=plotSetup("dqSeverson",255,xr,yr,{l:58,r:12,t:18,b:54}),{g,s,box,cv}=p;
    PC.drawAxes(g,box,niceTicks(xr[0],xr[1],4),niceTicks(yr[0],yr[1],4),s.x,s.y,"log₁₀ var ΔQ: cycle near "+integer(FACT.severson_read_cycle)+" vs reference →","EOL80 (cycles)",{grid:"both",xFmt:v=>fmt(v,1)});drawPoints(g,s,S.var_100_10,S.life,i=>cellColor(S.cells[i]),5,1);g.font=`600 10px ${FONT}`;g.fillStyle=PC.css("--text-secondary");S.cells.forEach((c,i)=>g.fillText(c,s.x(S.var_100_10[i])+8,s.y(S.life[i])+4));g.fillText("n = "+integer(S.cells.length)+" · illustration, not evidence",box.left+8,box.bottom-9);bindPointTip(cv,S.cells.map((_,i)=>[s.x(S.var_100_10[i]),s.y(S.life[i]),i]),i=>'<b>'+S.cells[i]+'</b><br><b>early log variance</b> '+fmt(S.var_100_10[i],3)+'<br><b>EOL80</b> '+S.life[i]);
  }
  $("dqTable").innerHTML='<thead><tr><th>battery</th><th>reference cycle</th><th>cycle nearest 100</th><th>EOL80, sustained '+META.sustain+'</th><th>ρ(log variance, remaining life)</th></tr></thead><tbody>'+CELLS.map(c=>{const q=D.dq.cells[c];return '<tr'+(c===cell?' style="background:var(--accent-soft)"':'')+'><td><span class="cell-dot" style="background:var('+cellToken(c)+')"></span>'+c+'</td><td class="num">'+q.ref_cycle+'</td><td class="num">'+q.cycle_at_100+'</td><td class="num">'+q.eol80+'</td><td class="num">'+fmt(q.rho_log10var_remaining,3)+'</td></tr>'}).join("")+'</tbody>';
  $("dqCaption").innerHTML='<b>Where the capacity is lost.</b> ΔQ grows fastest below about '+fmt(FACT.dq_low_voltage_v,1)+' V, the same low-voltage region where Severson’s LFP batteries lost the most capacity. Within each battery, the log variance rises with age and tracks remaining life (ρ between '+fmt(FACT.dq_rho_low,2)+' and '+fmt(FACT.dq_rho_high,2)+'), except '+CELLS[3]+' ('+fmt(D.dq.cells[CELLS[3]].rho_log10var_remaining,2)+'), whose polarisation episode inflates ΔQ early. “Early ΔQ(V) variance against lifetime” has one point per battery, four in all.';
}

let scoresBinding=null,umapBinding=null,capacityBinding=null;
function buildAnalysisTables(){
  const P=D.pca.pooled,U=D.umap;
  $("scoresTwin").querySelector("tbody").innerHTML=Array.from({length:NR},(_,r)=>'<tr data-key="'+r+'"><td class="num">'+r+'</td><td>'+CELLS[MX.cell[r]]+'</td><td class="num">'+MX.cycle[r]+'</td><td class="num">'+fmt(MX.soh[r],3)+'</td><td class="num">'+fmt(P.s1[r],3)+'</td><td class="num">'+fmt(P.s2[r],3)+'</td></tr>').join("");
  $("umapTwin").querySelector("tbody").innerHTML=Array.from({length:NR},(_,r)=>'<tr data-key="'+r+'"><td class="num">'+r+'</td><td>'+CELLS[MX.cell[r]]+'</td><td class="num">'+MX.cycle[r]+'</td><td class="num">'+fmt(U.x[r],3)+'</td><td class="num">'+fmt(U.y[r],3)+'</td></tr>').join("");
  $("capacityTwin").querySelector("tbody").innerHTML=Array.from({length:NR},(_,r)=>'<tr data-key="'+r+'"><td class="num">'+r+'</td><td>'+CELLS[MX.cell[r]]+'</td><td class="num">'+MX.cycle[r]+'</td><td class="num">'+fmt(MX.q_dis[r],3)+'</td><td class="num">'+fmt(P.s1[r],3)+'</td></tr>').join("");
  const opts=id=>({key:r=>Number(r.dataset.key),selected:()=>VIEW.get().row,onSelect:key=>VIEW.set({row:key},{source:id})});scoresBinding=PC.bindTableRows("#scoresTwin",opts("scores-table"));umapBinding=PC.bindTableRows("#umapTwin",opts("umap-table"));capacityBinding=PC.bindTableRows("#capacityTwin",opts("capacity-table"));
}
function refreshAnalysisBindings(){if(scoresBinding)scoresBinding.refresh();if(umapBinding)umapBinding.refresh();if(capacityBinding)capacityBinding.refresh()}

function drawDesign(sv){drawFullCycle();drawRaw(sv);drawXform(sv);drawMatrix(sv)}
function drawAnalysis(sv){drawPooled(sv);drawPerCell();drawUmap(sv);if(sv.evalView==="transfer"){drawLoco(sv);drawPc1Q(sv)}else drawDq(sv);refreshAnalysisBindings()}
function redrawVisible(){const s=VIEW.get();if(PCFolds.isOpen(document.getElementById("design-matrix")))drawDesign(s);if(PCFolds.isOpen(document.getElementById("analysis")))drawAnalysis(s)}
function onShow(i){if(i===1)drawDesign(VIEW.get());else if(i===2)drawAnalysis(VIEW.get())}

function renderState(s){syncControls(s);if(PCFolds.isOpen(document.getElementById("design-matrix")))drawDesign(s);if(PCFolds.isOpen(document.getElementById("analysis")))drawAnalysis(s)}

buildProvenance();buildFindings();buildDesignMatrix();buildAnalysisText();buildConclusions();buildGlossary();buildFooter();buildControls();buildMatrixTables();buildAnalysisTables();


if(D.provenance_card)PC.renderProvenance("#provCard",D.provenance_card);
VIEW.subscribe(renderState,{immediate:true});

PC.panels.dag.create(document.getElementById("workflowDag"), D.dag.steps, D.dag.options);
PC.registerRepaint(redrawVisible);
PC.repaint("initial", document);
